request.description:
epic-hn6 died by SIGINT (run_died 'cancelled: stopped by a signal' at 2026-10-04T21:19:50Z) with a non-terminal checkpoint, and the restart under the same run id wrote no `resumed` line: Run records StageResumed only for a FAILED or COMPLETED checkpoint. statusmodel's runEnding/lastTerminalLine therefore still reads the old run_died as the run's ending, so the LIVE run's model says lifecycle.phase 'cancelled' and buildRemaining suppresses the ETA beside 61 closed ticks. watch survives only because watchRunEnded checks liveness first; any surface keyed on the phase (overview classes, notify.ts, a liveness flicker) reads a working run as cancelled. Fix at the writer (every incarnation records a resume line over a standing terminal line) and add a test: run_died, then a restart, then the phase is the epic's.
evidence: internal/reconcile/reconcile.go:1955-1981 (StageResumed only for Completed/Failed); internal/statusmodel/build.go:853-890 (runEnding, lastTerminalLine); live: `ticfac status epic-hn6 --json` -> lifecycle.phase "cancelled", liveness.alive true, remaining null; ~/Development/ticfac/.ticfac/logs/epic-hn6/events.jsonl line 538 is the last run_died and no resumed follows

ticfac run epic-hn6 created this tick by absorbing the finding bcbe334e857cc166b6b6a1be32252f865561a0484954382812824718d649e5d9 (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-qjl/attempt-29): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A1. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/bcbe334e857cc166b6b6a1be32252f865561a0484954382812824718d649e5d9.json on the run branch.
request.title: Restart after a signal death leaves the live run's phase 'cancelled', no ETA
